title: Solar Flare
description: An abstract star of glowing filament lines wrapped in wild flames. Music swells and stirs it; each raised hand on Source B draws the flames up toward it.

parameters.label: Flare

parameters.label: Pace
parameters.description: Continuous flow of plasma across the turning star.

parameters.label: Surface Detail
parameters.description: Scale of the currents on the stellar surface.

parameters.label: Plasma Color
parameters.description: Base color of the stellar plasma.

parameters.label: Flame Reach

parameters.label: Hand Motion
parameters.description: Fast hand moves make the flames surge.

provenance.prompt_summary: Dark-centered solar body with layered plasma, uneven corona filaments and localized solar eruptions. Preserve the accepted four musical actions.
